channel.title: The Greenville Advocate - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Greenville Advocate (greenvilleadvocate.com)

item.title: Butler County Arrests Feb. 23 - March 1
item.description: Butler County law enforcement reports arrests made Feb. 23 – March 1, including charges ranging from DUI and drug offenses to domestic violence and cruelty to animals.

item.title: Middle school presents Black history program
item.description: Greenville Middle School’s 2026 Black History Program on Feb. 27 featured student-led tributes, performances and remarks from city leaders, highlighting education and remembrance.

item.title: Lions deliver dirt for inmate garden
item.description: Greenville Lions Club delivers 60 yards of topsoil to Butler County Jail’s inmate garden, teaming with local partners and overcoming a tense dump-truck scare to keep the project growing.

item.title: Butler County upcoming events
item.description: From school board meetings to library programs, exercise classes, recovery support and free skills training, see this roundup of upcoming Butler County events and how to submit your own.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Share your church or faith-based events in the Greenville Advocate’s free Faith Community Calendar. Email key details to news@greenvilleadvocate.com to be included.

item.title: Lions hear from Enterprise Rescue COO, staff
item.description: Enterprise Rescue COO Arnold Woodham told Greenville Lions Club how the nonprofit ambulance service, now serving Butler County, reinvests in staff and equipment to improve patient care.

item.title: Pate awarded nurtrition school friend of the year
item.description: Alabama Agriculture Commissioner Rick Pate named ASNA Friend of the Year for leading the Farm to School Incentive Program, boosting fresh Alabama-grown foods in cafeterias statewide.

item.title: McKenzie fifth grader earns state art honor
item.description: McKenzie fifth grader Caine Brooks placed second in Alabama’s 2026 State Superintendent’s Visual Arts Exhibit with a nature photograph, earning state recognition.

item.title: The command was issued
item.description: Rev. R.A. Mathews reflects on Iraq airstrikes, Daniel’s vision, and what the Bible says about heaven, angels, and a God who hears our prayers.

item.title: Turn around, look at me
item.description: A frog fable, a jealous church member, and biblical lessons on ego show why seeking credit can cost more than it gives, and why believers are called to serve for God, not applause.
